سَدِيلٌ The thing [or hanging] that is let down, or suspended, upon the [kind of camel-vehicle for women called] هَوْدَج: (S, O, K:) pl. [of mult.] سُدُولٌ and سَدَائِلُ and [of pauc.] أَسْدَالٌ: (S, O:) the first of which pls. is expl. by As as meaning the pieces of cloth with which the هودج is covered; as also سُدُونٌ. (TA.) ―
-b2- Also A thing [app. a hanging or curtain] that is extended across, or sideways, (يُعَرَّضُ,) in the space from side to side of the [tent called] خِبَآء (فِى سَعَةِ الخِبَآءِ): and (some say, M) the curtain of the حَجَلَة [or bridal canopy, &c.,] of a woman: (M, K:) pls. as above. (TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
